scope: Independent display-paced shaft animation on desktop and phone; retain constant marker appearance and direct speed scaling. Avoid unchanged numeric/detail DOM writes and recover fractional draw-cap cadence.

fpsCeiling.cadence: Browser requestAnimationFrame, bounded by selected ceiling. Does not request 1000 Hz. Explicit saved lower limits remain effective.

behavior.source: Only received simulation time is interpolated; no future prediction.
behavior.desktop: Uses source wall-clock interval; RAF draws only shaft canvas, without SDK reads, DOM refreshes or scene requests.
behavior.idle: Pause, no remaining received interval, stopped shafts, hidden/offscreen, unavailable or disabled renderer, and disposal stop scheduling.
behavior.renderer: Fixed-origin draw deadlines preserve timing remainder; stalled slots are discarded.
behavior.dom: Only changed formatted values or attributes are written. Sound detail rows rebuild only when changed.
